title: GUN WEAPON SYSTEMS (GWS) Request for Information
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSEA > NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER > NSWC DAHLGREN
description: *** UPDATE 11/24: The Industry Day slides and attendance have been posted within this notice. Industry slides are NOT for public release and has been restricted to company CAGE codes. If you were not able to attend industry day but would like access to the slides, please email Morgan Johnson with your CAGE Code at Morgan.e.johnson27.civ@us.navy.mil. Please refer to the Question and Answer section of this posting for questions asked at Industry Day.***ONLY SEAPORT MAC HOLDERS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR THIS OPPORTUNITY.*** This is a combined Sources Sought/Advance Notice only. The Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division (NSWCDD) Gun and Electric Weapon Systems (E Department) has a follow-on requirement for support across multiple effectors, ammunition and weapons systems. See the attached Advance Notice/Sources Sought for additional information. This notice is issued for informational and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. The Government is not requesting proposals at this time.
